title: The specified ringed-topos module pullback preserves filtered colimits
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites essentially small in a coefficient universe $w$. Let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a morphism of their sheaf topoi, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Let $R$ on $C$ and $R_I,S$ on $D$ be sheaves of commutative rings in universe $w$, fix an algebraic inverse-image presentation $I$ of $R_I=u^{-1}R$ and its module inverse image [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], and fix a ring map $c:R_I\to S$. Let $u^*:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(S)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] be identified on objects and morphisms with $M\mapsto S\otimes_{R_I}I(M)$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every filtered category $A$ whose object and morphism types lie in universe $w$, the functor $u^*$ preserves colimits of shape $A$. The site universes may differ independently from $w$.

proof.text: The functor from module sheaves to abelian sheaves preserves colimits: express a module colimit by module sheafification and use its invertible counit. This is the proved source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf in WeilConjectures/Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Sheafification.lean, lines 43-60.

Forgetting abelian sheaves to set sheaves preserves filtered colimits. The presheaf forgetful functor does so sectionwise. Its compatibility with sheafification identifies the sheafified presheaf colimit with the desired underlying sheaf colimit. Transport this compatibility from the small model of the site in universe w, with the structured-arrow limit instances from relative essential smallness. Forgetting module structure to set sheaves reflects isomorphisms; since it preserves these colimits, it reflects them as well.

The natural underlying-sheaf isomorphism of I [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image] identifies its composite with the target forgetful functor with source forgetting followed by uInv. The latter preserves filtered colimits by steps 1-2 and the given adjunction. Reflection of colimits by target forgetting now proves preservation by I.modules.

Scalar extension is left adjoint to restriction. Use [lem-weil-pbc-scalar-extension-hom] sectionwise: evaluate a map on 1 tensor m; the inverse sends s tensor m to s times g(m). The tensor restriction formula and naturality of module maps show that these define inverse presheaf morphisms. The module sheafification adjunction descends the equivalence to sheaves. Pre- and postcomposition naturality are checked on 1 tensor m, and therefore give the scalar-extension adjunction. Its left adjoint preserves all colimits.

Compose the two preservation results. The supplied object and morphism identifications produce a natural isomorphism from I.modules followed by the explicit scalar-extension functor to uStar, with components eqToIso(hobj M).symm. The hmap equation proves its naturality. Transfer colimit preservation along this isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem preservesFilteredColimits_ringedToposPullback
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    (K : Type w) [Category.{w} K] [IsFiltered K] :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape K uStar
